# Waymark 0.5.10

- Added a location toggle beside pet sorting: All locations → Verteron only → Altgard only → Abyss only.
- Filters the pet library by recorded farming sources, and narrows location labels and pet detail locations to the selected territory. All Abyss layers are treated as Abyss.
- Defaults to All locations and remembers your selection across launches, backups and synced saves. Existing sort, search, level and genus choices remain independent.
- Abyss filtering uses recorded source information; it does not invent precise spawn coordinates where those are unavailable.
